instruction:
Implement project_usage(receipt) in telemetry_usage.py.

The function must return a list of Agent Dispatch-compatible usage records. Every returned item must contain exactly: kind, value, unit, source.

Project only these fields, in this exact order when present and valid:
1. observation.wall_seconds -> elapsed-time / seconds / observed
2. observation.workload.model_calls_started -> model-calls-started / calls / observed
3. observation.workload.model_calls_completed -> model-calls-completed / calls / observed
4. observation.workload.tool_calls_started -> tool-calls-started / calls / observed
5. observation.workload.tool_calls_completed -> tool-calls-completed / calls / observed
6. observation.input_tokens -> input-tokens / tokens / authoritative
7. observation.output_tokens -> output-tokens / tokens / authoritative
8. observation.cache_read_tokens -> cache-read-tokens / tokens / authoritative
9. observation.cache_write_tokens -> cache-write-tokens / tokens / authoritative
10. observation.cost -> cost / usd / authoritative
11. observation.human_interventions -> human-interventions / count / observed
12. observation.workload.client_wall_seconds_total -> model-client-wall-time / seconds / observed
13. observation.workload.request_message_bytes_total -> request-message-bytes / bytes / derived
14. observation.workload.request_tool_schema_bytes_total -> request-tool-schema-bytes / bytes / derived
15. observation.workload.output_text_bytes_total -> output-text-bytes / bytes / derived
16. observation.workload.reasoning_bytes_total -> reasoning-bytes / bytes / derived
17. observation.workload.tool_argument_bytes_total -> tool-argument-bytes / bytes / derived

Rules:
- missing or null means omit the record; missing is never zero;
- explicit numeric zero is valid and must be retained;
- booleans, negative numbers, strings, NaN, and infinities are invalid and must be omitted;
- ignore unrelated receipt fields;
- do not normalize, compare, or combine token counts across models;
- do not mutate the input receipt;
- use only the Python standard library.
